_what: Why a tools/call is refused before it runs, in words written for the AI that made it, read by src/tool-call-refusal.mjs. `retry` says whether asking again can help: no (do not repeat it), after_listing (call tools/list or find_tool_for_job first), correct_the_call (fix the named part, then call again). Add a reason as a row; the code names none of them but looks each up here.

malformed_call.words: The call was not a tool name with an object of arguments. Send name as text and arguments as an object.

unknown_tool.words: No tool of that name is in your current tool list. Do not repeat the call: list your tools (tools/list) or use find_tool_for_job to find the one for this job.

ambiguous_name.words: That name matches more than one tool in your current list once spelling is ignored: {matches}. Call one of them by its exact name.

did_you_mean.words: No tool is named exactly that, but one differs only in spelling: {matches}. Call it by that exact name.

check_failed.words: This call could not be checked before it ran, so it did not run. Try again shortly; if it keeps failing, say so to the person.
